item.title: Brewers, with 'unbelievable' Trevor Megill, open series vs. Reds
item.description: Some relievers might hit the figurative wall late in the season, but Milwaukee Brewers closer Trevor Megill appears to be sharper than ever.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Some relievers might hit the figurative wall late in the season, but Milwaukee Brewers closer Trevor Megill appears to be sharper than ever. Megill has not allowed an earned run in his last 14 appearances for Milwaukee, which will open a three-game series against the host Cincinnati Reds on Friday evening. "Trevor has been unbelievable," Brewers manager Pat Murphy said. "He's been magnificent and he's trusted. Great, great member of that bullpen." Milwaukee (87-54) is eight games ahead of the second-place Chicago Cubs in the National League Central with 21 games remaining. Chicago salvaged a split of a four-game series between the teams with a 2-1 victory on Thursday. Cincinnati (67-73) was idle on Thursday after taking two of three games from the San Diego Padres. The Reds are 6 1/2 games behind the Arizona Diamondbacks for the third and final NL wild-card spot. The MLB-best Brewers boast a stellar bullpen led by Megill, who was named the NL's Reliever of the Month on Thursday. He allowed one unearned run in 11 appearances in August and was 8-for-8 in save opportunities. "It's always nice (to be honored)," said Megill, who is 2-3 with a 2.19 ERA and 25 saves this season. "Although there's a lot of hard work, a lot of good plays behind me. A lot of wins. August is kind of the dog days of every season. So to stay locked in like that was a good sign." Milwaukee's bullpen has allowed a total of one run over the last three games covering 10 2/3 innings. Cincinnati can claim its own award winner in first baseman Sal Stewart, who was named NL Rookie of the Month. Stewart, 22, has 31 homers and leads the majors with 105 RBIs. He hit .304 with eight homers and 21 RBIs in August. "It's remarkable," Reds closer Emilio Pagan said. "If I had a vote, he's Rookie of the Year. Obviously, I'm biased. And he's getting stronger down the stretch, which is really hard for young players to do. His at-bats seem to be getting better." Cincinnati will send right-hander Rhett Lowder (6-8, 5.14 ERA) to the mound in the series opener. He allowed three runs over five innings in a 10-8 road victory over the Cubs last Friday. "They didn't make it easy on me by any means from the jump," Lowder said. "I got behind in some counts early, but credit to them. They were fouling off a ton of tough pitches and not swinging at balls. Made it tough." Milwaukee's Jake Bauers is 5-for-8 with two homers against Lowder, who is 0-3 with a 6.28 ERA in three career starts vs. Milwaukee -- including 0-2 with a 7.84 ERA in two outings this season. The Brewers will counter with left-hander Shane Drohan (7-5, 3.75 ERA), who allowed one run over five innings in a 5-3 home win over the Texas Rangers last Saturday. Drohan walked one and struck out six for his first victory since July 31. In August, he went 1-1 with a 4.84 ERA in five starts covering 22 1/3 innings. Drohan has not posted a decision in his two career outings vs. Cincinnati, allowing a total of two runs on 11 hits in 10 innings. --Field Level Media

item.title: Cobre sube por disminución de existencias, apunta a racha alcista de 10 semanas
item.description: El cobre subía el viernes y se encaminaba a registrar su décima subida semanal consecutiva, gracias al apoyo que le proporcionaban la disminución de las existencias fuera de Estados Unidos y la debilidad del dólar.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El cobre subía el viernes y se encaminaba a registrar su décima subida semanal consecutiva, gracias al apoyo que le proporcionaban la disminución de las existencias fuera de Estados Unidos y la debilidad del dólar. * A las 0900 GMT, el contrato de referencia del cobre a tres meses en la Bolsa de Metales de Londres (LME) ganaba un 0,3%, a 14.373 dólares por tonelada, acercándose a su máximo histórico de 14.527,5 dólares. * El metal se encamina a un alza semanal del 0,5%. Ha subido cada semana desde la que comenzó el 29 de junio, ya que el aumento vertiginoso de las existencias en Estados Unidos , ante la posibilidad de que se apliquen aranceles a las importaciones, está tensando el mercado en el resto del mundo. * Las importaciones de cobre de Estados Unidos en julio tocaron un pico histórico, mientras que los datos de la Bolsa de Futuros de Shanghái mostraron el viernes que las existencias de cobre cayeron un 13% respecto a la semana pasada, a 63.000 toneladas, el nivel más bajo desde enero de 2024. * Las existencias de cobre en la LME descendieron en 475 toneladas, y se registraron órdenes de retirada de otras 1.550 toneladas. * La incertidumbre arancelaria debería seguir respaldando al cobre, aunque los precios, ya elevados, "probablemente limitarán las subidas a corto plazo", señaló en una nota BMI, una unidad de Fitch Solutions. * El dólar bajaba por menores expectativas de un alza de las tasas de interés tras los comentarios moderados del gobernador de la Reserva Federal Christopher Waller. Un billete verde más barato respalda a las materias primas denominadas en la divisa estadounidense, al hacerlas más asequibles a los compradores con otras divisas. * En otros metales básicos, el aluminio cedía un 0,5%, a 3.295 dólares; el zinc ganaba un 0,5%, a 3.932,5 dólares; el plomo subía un 0,5%, a 1.912,5 dólares; el níquel avanzaba un 0,2%, a 16.825 dólares; y el estaño restaba un 0,4%, a 54.700 dólares.

item.title: Chinese shipper COSCO denies its vessels spied for Beijing
item.description: China's state-owned shipping giant COSCO rejected allegations it used concealed equipment on its vessels to collect intelligence for Beijing, calling the claims "totally unfounded" and false.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China's state-owned shipping giant COSCO rejected allegations it used concealed equipment on its vessels to collect intelligence for Beijing, calling the claims "totally unfounded" and false. Reuters on Tuesday [USN:L1N44S0ZA TEXT:"reported"], citing two senior Trump administration officials, that COSCO used the equipment to spy on military communications near the coastlines of target nations including the United States. The officials, who spoke on condition of anonymity, said COSCO has a decades-long intelligence-collection partnership with Beijing, which allows China to collect communication signals from vessels and aircraft operating across Europe, North America and Asia. "COSCO SHIPPING has always adhered to market‑oriented operations and compliance practices across all our global businesses," the company said in a statement. "All communication, navigation, safety and operational equipment installed on our vessels is used solely for legitimate commercial purposes, including navigation safety, ship-to-shore communications and emergency response," it said. COSCO added that none of the equipment on board its vessels was used for intercepting military communications or gathering intelligence. Chinese President Xi Jinping is expected to [USN:L4N44R00E TEXT:"visit Washington"] on September 24 for talks with U.S. President Donald Trump, though Beijing has yet to formally confirm the date of the trip. The summit is expected to focus on a range of sensitive security and trade issues . China's embassy in Washington has previously said Beijing would never ask any company or individual to "collect or provide data, information or intelligence located abroad against local laws."

item.title: UE envia embarcações ao Canal da Mancha para ajudar a enfrentar “crise imigratória”
item.description: A agência de fronteiras da União Europeia enviará embarcações ao Canal da Mancha e ao Mar do Norte para ajudar nas buscas e no resgate de imigrantes, informaram autoridades nesta sexta-feira, dias após os líderes da França e do Reino Unido se reunirem para discutir a questão da imigração.
item.dc:creator: Sudip Kar-Gupta
item.content:encoded: A agência de fronteiras da União Europeia enviará embarcações ao Canal da Mancha e ao Mar do Norte para ajudar nas buscas e no resgate de imigrantes, informaram autoridades nesta sexta-feira, dias após os líderes da França e do Reino Unido se reunirem para discutir a questão da imigração. A agência Frontex enviará dois barcos espanhóis de setembro a outubro e, em seguida, um da Lituânia até janeiro, para se juntar às patrulhas francesas, informaram as autoridades responsáveis pela área. O Canal da Mancha é uma das rotas marítimas mais movimentadas do mundo, e muitos imigrantes já morreram em suas fortes correntes ao tentar atravessar da França para o Reino Unido. Traficantes de pessoas costumam sobrecarregar os botes, deixando-os mal flutuando. Em agosto, a guarda costeira francesa teve que resgatar 157 pessoas de um barco que pegou fogo. “Em resposta à crise imigratória em curso no Canal da Mancha, a Frontex enviará embarcações de patrulha para complementar temporariamente os recursos franceses envolvidos em operações de busca e resgate”, dizia um comunicado da Prefeitura Marítima do Canal da Mancha e do Mar do Norte, com sede na França. A imigração é uma das questões políticas mais polêmicas da Europa, inclusive no Reino Unido, onde o Partido Trabalhista, atualmente no poder, enfrenta o desafio do partido populista Reform UK, que prometeu impedir a chegada de imigrantes em barcos. O Reino Unido anunciou em abril que pagaria à França até 660 milhões de libras (892,72 milhões de dólares) no âmbito de um acordo de segurança de fronteiras de três anos para coibir as travessias ilegais de imigrantes pelo Canal da Mancha, com parte do financiamento condicionada aos resultados. No ano passado, ambos os países concordaram com um esquema piloto do tipo “um entra, um sai”, segundo o qual a França aceitará o retorno de pessoas sem documentos que chegam ao Reino Unido em pequenos barcos, em troca de o Reino Unido concordar em aceitar um número igual de requerentes de asilo legítimos com laços familiares britânicos.

item.title: Premiê do Japão vai manter ministra das Finanças em reforma ministerial, dizem fontes
item.description: A primeira-ministra do Japão, Sanae Takaichi, vai manter Satsuki Katayama no cargo de ministra das Finanças em uma reforma ministerial que provavelmente ocorrerá ainda este mês, segundo quatro fontes do governo a par do assunto.
item.dc:creator: Tamiyuki Kihara, Makiko Yamazaki
item.content:encoded: A primeira-ministra do Japão, Sanae Takaichi, vai manter Satsuki Katayama no cargo de ministra das Finanças em uma reforma ministerial que provavelmente ocorrerá ainda este mês, segundo quatro fontes do governo a par do assunto. A manutenção no cargo indica uma preferência pela continuidade na política financeira no momento em que o governo conduz negociações com os Estados Unidos sobre câmbio e se prepara para aprovar uma redução do imposto sobre o consumo de alimentos. Katayama desempenhou um papel fundamental nas negociações com o secretário do Tesouro norte-americano, Scott Bessent, sobre uma rara intervenção conjunta dos EUA e do Japão no mercado do iene no final de julho, uma operação que destacou a estreita cooperação entre os dois países. “Takaichi valoriza o papel de Katayama na ajuda à realização da intervenção coordenada e sua relação próxima com Bessent”, disse uma das fontes do governo, que se recusaram a se identificar já que o assunto não é de domínio público. “Retirar Katayama neste momento poderia ser mal interpretado pelos mercados, em um momento em que Bessent intensificou a pressão sobre o Japão”, disse a fonte. No mês passado, Katayama afirmou que ela e Bessent mantiveram cerca de 10 discussões, incluindo reuniões online, destacando a proximidade entre ambos. Economistas afirmaram que a substituição de Katayama poderia desestabilizar os mercados caso um sucessor fosse visto como menos preocupado com os riscos decorrentes de um iene mais fraco ou do aumento dos rendimentos dos títulos públicos. (Reportagem de Leika Kihara, Makiko Yamazaki e Tamiyuki Kihara)

item.title: US job growth expected to rebound in August; unemployment rate forecast steady at 4.1%
item.description: U.S. payrolls growth likely rebounded in August as the drag from local government education reversed, but the anticipated recovery could be limited by job losses related to the termination of Temporary Protected Status for Haitian immigrants.
item.dc:creator: Lucia Mutikani
item.content:encoded: U.S. payrolls growth likely rebounded in August as the drag from local government education reversed, but the anticipated recovery could be limited by job losses related to the termination of Temporary Protected Status for Haitian immigrants. The Labor Department's closely watched employment report on Friday is expected to paint a picture of a labor market that economists say remains in a "slow hire, slow fire" mode, with the unemployment rate forecast to have held steady at 4.1% last month. Labor market momentum has decelerated after surging in the spring, partly blamed on the [USN:L6N44V0ZE TEXT:"oil price shock"] and supply [USN:S0N4490BU TEXT:"chain strains"] from the U.S.-led war with Iran. Job growth was hobbled by President Donald Trump's sweeping import tariffs in 2025. "Businesses felt some of the problems from 2025 were behind, then all of a sudden we get another black swan event that introduces a new set of uncertainties," said Brian Bethune, an economics professor at Boston College. "We saw significant problems with supply chains, oil and fuel prices went up, and that situation has not changed. So that's why the job numbers have dropped from what we saw in the first few months." Nonfarm payrolls likely increased by 56,000 jobs last month after declining 23,000 in July, according to a Reuters survey of economists. Estimates ranged from as low as another loss of 25,000 jobs to as high as a 121,000 gain. August payrolls have a tendency to undershoot expectations, with economists blaming a summer seasonal quirk. Local government education employment dropped by 49,600 in July, and a rebound was expected to underpin payrolls in August. A recovery was also anticipated in the leisure and hospitality industry after losing jobs for two straight months. Economists, however, cautioned that those gains could be offset by the termination of TPS for [USN:L6N4431EV TEXT:"hundreds of thousands"] of Haitian immigrants, which impacted their work permits. "We are assuming a 15,000 drag on payrolls from the revocation of Temporary Protected Status for unauthorized Haitian immigrants," said Michael Gapen, chief economist at Morgan Stanley. "It could be much larger. The TPS-affected Haitians account for an estimated 160,000 of national payrolls." TEMPORARY DRAG FROM TPS TERMINATION The drag, which some economists said could be temporary, would be evident in labor-intensive services sectors like healthcare, mostly care-giving. Some immigrants who lost their TPS could move to other visa categories. "If payroll employment in August is a bit weaker than we expect, we would not necessarily dismiss weakness as only a result of the TPS expiration, as other data like hiring plans have been soft," said Veronica Clark, an economist at Citigroup. The Trump administration is cracking down on immigration, through deportations and revocations of TPS, shrinking the labor pool. That has drastically reduced the number of jobs economists say the economy needs to create to keep up with growth in the working-age population. Economists estimate the so-called break-even rate at between zero and 50,000 jobs per month. Reduced labor supply, also the result of retirements, is keeping the unemployment rate lower, though some economists expected the jobless rate to rise to 4.2% in August, arguing the recent drop in the labor force participation rate was excessive. "Participation has fallen a full percentage point since the start of the year, a decline that appears outsized relative to broader labor market conditions," said Gregory Daco, chief economist at EY-Parthenon. "The drop mainly reflects reduced population growth, aging demographics and rising retirements, and lower immigration flows." Barring a shock, August's employment report was unlikely to impact the Federal Reserve's interest rate decision at the U.S. central bank's September 15-16 policy meeting, with the focus on next week's Consumer Price Index report. The labor market is not a source of inflation, with annual wage growth estimated to have slowed to 3.0% last month from 3.2% in July. Fed Governor [USN:S0N4490CF TEXT:"Christopher Waller"] said at a Reuters NEXT Newsmaker event on Thursday that he was inclined to argue in favor of keeping rates steady this month if upcoming data confirmed inflation pressures were cooling off. Financial markets saw a 50% chance of a rate hike this month, down from 63.2% on Wednesday, according to CME's FedWatch tool. Concerns about inflation and lack of forward guidance from the Fed have helped to boost U.S. Treasury yields, which economists said was a problem for the central bank. Rising yields drove the 30-year fixed mortgage rate to a more than one-year high of 6.71% this week, data from mortgage finance agency Freddie Mac showed on Thursday, which could further undermine a struggling housing market. "The markets have already dialed in tightening on the yield curve; we got 75 basis points of tightening and that's going to slow down the economy," said Boston College's Bethune. "One of the reasons the long-term rates have been going up is because it's pricing in uncertainty about what the Fed is going to do. That uncertainty is connected with political intimidation."

item.title: Frontex schickt Schiffe zur Rettung von Migranten in den Ärmelkanal
item.description: Die europäische Grenzschutzagentur Frontex unterstützt künftig die Seenotrettung von Migranten im Ärmelkanal und in der Nordsee mit eigenen Schiffen. Dies teilten die zuständigen Behörden am Freitag mit. Demnach sollen von September bis Oktober zwei spanische Schiffe und anschließend bis Januar ein litauisches Schiff die französischen Patrouillen verstärken.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die europäische Grenzschutzagentur Frontex unterstützt künftig die Seenotrettung von Migranten im Ärmelkanal und in der Nordsee mit eigenen Schiffen. Dies teilten die zuständigen Behörden am Freitag mit. Demnach sollen von September bis Oktober zwei spanische Schiffe und anschließend bis Januar ein litauisches Schiff die französischen Patrouillen verstärken. Die Entscheidung folgt auf ein Treffen von Frankreichs Präsident Emmanuel Macron mit dem britischen Premierminister Andy Burnham, bei dem auch über Migrationsfragen beraten wurde. Frontex wolle mit dem Einsatz die französischen Kapazitäten bei Such- und Rettungseinsätzen vorübergehend ergänzen, hieß es in einer Erklärung der französischen Meerespräfektur für den Ärmelkanal und die Nordsee. Der Ärmelkanal gehört zu den am stärksten befahrenen Schifffahrtsstraßen der Welt. Wegen der starken Strömung ist die Überquerung von Frankreich nach Großbritannien in oft überladenen Schlauchbooten hochgefährlich. Immer wieder kommen dabei Menschen ums Leben. Im August musste die französische Küstenwache 157 Menschen von einem brennenden Boot retten. Das Thema Migration ist in Europa politisch hochgradig umstritten. In Großbritannien steht die regierende Labour-Partei unter dem Druck der populistischen Partei Reform UK, die ein Ende der Überfahrten mit Migrantenbooten fordert. Großbritannien hatte im April vereinbart, Frankreich im Rahmen eines dreijährigen Grenzsicherungsabkommens bis zu 780 Millionen Euro (660 Millionen Pfund) zu zahlen, um illegale Überfahrten zu verhindern. Ein Teil der Gelder ist an Erfolge gekoppelt. Im vergangenen Jahr hatten sich beide Länder zudem auf ein Pilotprojekt geeinigt. Demnach nimmt Frankreich Migranten ohne Papiere zurück, die mit kleinen Booten in Großbritannien ankommen. Im Gegenzug nimmt Großbritannien die gleiche Anzahl von Asylsuchenden mit familiären Bindungen auf.

item.title: La fiscalía rumana imputa a Andrew Tate por tráfico de menores y blanqueo de capitales
item.description: La fiscalía rumana imputó oficialmente el viernes al "influencer" de redes sociales Andrew Tate por tráfico de menores, blanqueo de capitales, relaciones sexuales con una menor e intimidación de testigos, y a su hermano Tristan por complicidad, años después de que comenzaran las investigaciones.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La fiscalía rumana imputó oficialmente el viernes al "influencer" de redes sociales Andrew Tate por tráfico de menores, blanqueo de capitales, relaciones sexuales con una menor e intimidación de testigos, y a su hermano Tristan por complicidad, años después de que comenzaran las investigaciones. Los hermanos Tate, exluchadores de "kickboxing" con doble nacionalidad, estadounidense y británica, fueron detenidos en Miami a finales de julio tras solicitar Reino Unido su extradición. Residentes principalmente en Rumanía desde 2017, son objeto de una investigación penal en ese país por delitos que incluyen la trata de personas desde diciembre de 2022. La fiscalía rumana dijo que los hermanos Tate captaban a sus víctimas seduciéndolas y fingiendo querer una relación o casarse con ellas, antes de obligarlas a producir contenido pornográfico para un negocio de cámaras web. Los hermanos han negado todas las acusaciones. "Examinaremos todos los aspectos de (la acusación) con el mismo nivel de rigor e impugnaremos cualquier deficiencia probatoria, procesal o jurídica a través del proceso judicial adecuado", dijo en un comunicado Eugen Vidineac, un abogado rumano de los Tate. "Nuestros clientes siguen rechazando las acusaciones que se les imputan." LA FISCALÍA DESCRIBE EL CASO RELACIONADO CON UNA MENOR DE 15 AÑOS Los hermanos Tate permanecen en prisión en EEUU mientras un juez decide sobre la solicitud de su extradición a Reino Unido, donde se los acusa de violación. El portavoz de la unidad fiscal rumana contra el crimen organizado DIICOT, que investiga a los Tate, dijo que no estaba claro de inmediato si la unidad solicitará su extradición desde Estados Unidos. Los Tate pueden ser juzgados en ausencia en Rumanía, pero el juicio no comenzará de inmediato. Según la legislación rumana, el auto de acusación se remite a una sala de instrucción, donde un juez examinará el expediente para garantizar su legalidad. Aunque la ley establece que el juez de la sala de instrucción dispone de 60 días para finalizar el informe, los autos de acusación suelen tardar mucho más tiempo. La DIICOT afirmó que una de las víctimas de Andrew Tate tenía 15 años cuando él la sedujo en Reino Unido en 2012, antes de trasladarla a Bucarest, la capital rumana, y de recurrir a la violencia física y la intimidación psicológica para explotarla sexualmente, obligándola a producir contenido pornográfico para redes sociales. Su hermano Tristan fue cómplice, según la unidad, y recurrió a la agresión física para coaccionar a la víctima. Los fiscales afirmaron que los hermanos se quedaron con 1,25 millones de dólares de los ingresos generados por la víctima a través de videochats, lo que supone aproximadamente el 80% de todas sus ganancias. Añadieron que los hermanos intentaron blanquear los fondos comprando cuatro vehículos de lujo. Los hermanos ya habían sido imputados en Rumanía por delitos de trata de personas, pero a finales de 2024 el tribunal de apelación de Bucarest devolvió el caso a la fiscalía tras considerar inadmisibles algunas pruebas. Andrew Tate, que se autodenomina misógino, había declarado anteriormente que se mudó a Rumanía porque allí las fuerzas del orden eran más laxas. Ambos hermanos han aumentado su número de seguidores, en su mayoría hombres jóvenes, construyéndose una imagen ostentosa y de supermacho en la que conducen vehículos rápidos y salen con mujeres guapas.

item.title: Milei intensifica reivindicações de soberania das Malvinas com sanções sobre petróleo
item.description: O presidente argentino, Javier Milei, afirmou que aplicará sanções às empresas petrolíferas que realizarem perfurações nas Ilhas Malvinas, reforçando as reivindicações do país quanto à soberania sobre o território ultramarino britânico.
item.dc:creator: Nicolás Misculin, Sarah Young
item.content:encoded: O presidente argentino, Javier Milei, afirmou que aplicará sanções às empresas petrolíferas que realizarem perfurações nas Ilhas Malvinas, reforçando as reivindicações do país quanto à soberania sobre o território ultramarino britânico. As declarações de Milei, feitas em um discurso nacional televisionado na quinta-feira, ocorreram dias depois que o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, afirmou que estava revendo a posição neutra dos EUA em relação ao remoto arquipélago no Atlântico Sul. A perspectiva de empresas petrolíferas realizarem exploração nas ilhas — que a Argentina chama de Malvinas — representa uma ameaça urgente aos interesses argentinos, disse Milei, 44 anos depois que seu país foi derrotado pelo Reino Unido em uma guerra pela soberania. Milei, aliado de Trump, mencionou a possível mudança na posição dos EUA e disse que os “ventos de mudança” favoreciam a reivindicação argentina. Ele afirmou que estava enviando ao Congresso um projeto de lei com o objetivo de fortalecer a resposta da Argentina a violações de sua soberania. POSIÇÃO BRITÂNICA “INABALÁVEL” O Reino Unido, que controla o território desde 1833, afirmou na sexta-feira que sua posição sobre as ilhas é “inabalável”. “As ilhas são britânicas e permanecerão assim, pois essa é a posição esmagadora dos habitantes das ilhas”, disse o ministro das Relações Exteriores britânico, Ed Miliband, no X. “O direito deles à autodeterminação é primordial, fundamentado no direito internacional, e nós o defenderemos com determinação.” O ministro da Defesa britânico, Wes Streeting, acrescentou que as palavras de Milei refletem “a política interna da Argentina”. Milei já havia defendido a diplomacia como a melhor forma de buscar a reivindicação da Argentina sobre as Malvinas, mas, com mais perfurações de petróleo previstas para os próximos meses e as repetidas menções de Trump às ilhas, ele agora está adotando um tom mais duro. Trump disse à GB News na quinta-feira que não tinha certeza se o Reino Unido estaria preparado para lutar pelas ilhas novamente. “Simplesmente não sei se vocês têm capacidade para fazer isso”, declarou Trump. “A questão das Malvinas é muito interessante porque o seu país não é mais o mesmo de 20 ou 25 anos atrás.” Uma possível mudança na posição dos EUA em relação às Malvinas foi incluída entre uma série de opções consideradas pelo Pentágono no início deste ano para pressionar aliados da Otan que, em sua opinião, não apoiaram as operações militares dos EUA na guerra contra o Irã.

item.title: La UE envía barcos al Canal de la Mancha para ayudar a hacer frente a la "crisis migratoria"
item.description: La agencia fronteriza de la Unión Europea enviará embarcaciones al Canal de la Mancha y al mar del Norte para ayudar en la búsqueda y el rescate de migrantes, informaron el viernes las autoridades, pocos días después de que los líderes de Francia y Reino Unido se reunieran para tratar el tema de la migración.
item.dc:creator: Sudip Kar-Gupta
item.content:encoded: La agencia fronteriza de la Unión Europea enviará embarcaciones al Canal de la Mancha y al mar del Norte para ayudar en la búsqueda y el rescate de migrantes, informaron el viernes las autoridades, pocos días después de que los líderes de Francia y Reino Unido se reunieran para tratar el tema de la migración. La agencia Frontex enviará dos embarcaciones españolas entre septiembre y octubre, y posteriormente una de Lituania hasta enero, para sumarse a las patrullas francesas, según las autoridades responsables de la zona. El Canal de la Mancha es una de las rutas marítimas más transitadas del mundo, y muchos migrantes han perdido la vida en sus fuertes corrientes al intentar cruzar de Francia a Reino Unido. Los traficantes de personas suelen sobrecargar las lanchas neumáticas, lo que hace que apenas se mantengan a flote. En agosto, los guardacostas franceses tuvieron que rescatar a 157 personas de una embarcación que se incendió. "En respuesta a la actual crisis migratoria en el Canal de la Mancha, Frontex desplegará buques patrulleros para complementar temporalmente los recursos franceses que participan en operaciones de búsqueda y rescate", según un comunicado de la Prefectura Marítima del Canal de la Mancha y del mar del Norte, con sede en Francia. La migración es uno de los temas políticos más polémicos de Europa, incluso en Reino Unido, donde el Partido Laborista, actualmente en el poder, se enfrenta al desafío del partido populista Reform UK, que se ha comprometido a impedir la llegada de migrantes en embarcaciones. Reino Unido anunció en abril que pagaría a Francia hasta 660 millones de libras esterlinas (892,72 millones de dólares) en el marco de un acuerdo de seguridad fronteriza de tres años para frenar los cruces ilegales de migrantes por el Canal de la Mancha, estando parte de la financiación supeditada a los resultados. El año pasado, ambos países acordaron un programa piloto de "uno entra, uno sale", en virtud del cual Francia aceptará el retorno de personas indocumentadas que lleguen a Reino Unido en pequeñas embarcaciones, a cambio de que Reino Unido se comprometa a acoger a un número equivalente de solicitantes de asilo legítimos con vínculos familiares en el país. (1 dólar = 0,7393 libras)

item.title: China may challenge Brazil in chicken export markets within a decade, Rabobank says
item.description: China could emerge as a competitor to Brazil in key chicken meat markets including the Middle East within the next decade after becoming a net exporter in 2025, Rabobank analyst Chenjun Pan told Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China could emerge as a competitor to Brazil in key chicken meat markets including the Middle East within the next decade after becoming a net exporter in 2025, Rabobank analyst Chenjun Pan told Reuters. China is currently Brazil's top chicken export destination, but surging domestic production is generating exportable surpluses of cuts such as breast meat, which Chinese consumers rarely eat. The world's fifth-largest chicken exporter in 2025, China shipped just over 1 million metric tons, according to Brazilian meat lobby ABPA. Brazil, the top exporter, shipped 5.3 million tons. Pan said potential competition in the Middle East, Asia and Africa could emerge within the next decade. Chinese chicken production grew about 7% in 2025 and more than 9% year-on-year in the first half of 2026, Rabobank said. Chinese chicken export destinations include Russia, Hong Kong, North Korea and Middle Eastern countries. China does not compete with Brazil in the European Union, Japan or South Korea, where chicken vaccinated against bird flu is not accepted. Beijing has promoted chicken production to reduce reliance on pork, following the African swine fever crisis of 2019–2021.

item.title: Tigers intend to keep fighting in doubleheader vs. Guardians
item.description: This weekend will mark the Detroit Tigers' biggest test yet. If they are to extend their streak of postseason appearances to three, they need to fare well in their four-game series at the Cleveland Guardians.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: This weekend will mark the Detroit Tigers' biggest test yet. If they are to extend their streak of postseason appearances to three, they need to fare well in their four-game series at the Cleveland Guardians. The set will begin with a split doubleheader on Friday. Tigers right-hander Keider Montero (9-8, 3.24 ERA) will start the afternoon game against Guardians left-hander Logan Allen (0-0, 3.77). Detroit's Andrew Sears (0-1, 6.75) will work the nightcap in a battle of left-handers against Cleveland's Foster Griffin (15-4, 3.21). "This has been a really hard stretch and very much a roller-coaster season," Tigers manager A.J. Hinch said. "I know in the big scheme of things, there is a lot of frustration around this team, but we're not going to quit." Cleveland (70-70) sits in the third American League wild-card position, one-half game ahead of the Toronto Blue Jays and Texas Rangers and 5 1/2 games in front of Detroit (64-75). The Tigers survived their biggest gut-check of the year on Wednesday, pulling out an 11-6 victory in 12 innings at the Minnesota Twins. Minnesota had won the previous two games by a combined 26-3 score and rallied from three down in the eighth on Wednesday. Detroit fixture Spencer Torkelson saved the day with a two-run homer in the 12th inning, when the visitors scored five runs off Tommy Nance. "The way the last couple of weeks have gone, we very easily could have said, 'All right, we're done. It's not our night,'" Torkelson said. "This is one of my favorite wins in a long time because of how proud I am of the way we stayed in the fight." Montero had alternated wins and losses since July 22, going 3-3 with a 3.29 ERA. He has made two starts against the Guardians this year after facing them for the initial time in 2025, compiling a 1-0 record and 1.53 ERA over 17 2/3 innings and three games. Sears made his major league debut with an Aug. 23 loss at the Kansas City Royals, but this marks his first start and appearance vs. Cleveland. The Guardians have lost four of the first six games on their 10-game homestand, dropping two of three to both the Royals and Blue Jays. After leading the Central Division for most of the first three months, Cleveland now is fighting to hang onto the last playoff position. Guardians rookie Travis Bazzana made a splash by hitting .311 in his first month in the big leagues, leading to his All-Star selection via the players' ballot. Much like the entire Cleveland team, Bazzana has slumped with a .204 average since June 1. He also has been shaky at second base, making two glaring mistakes in the last two games. "When you're going through your first season and you want to be great for your teammates and you go through a stretch where it's been a little bit tough, you're going to wear it," manager Stephen Vogt said. "But we know Travis is a really good player and he's going to bounce out of it." Bazzana is hitless in 12 at-bats this homestand and hasn't made himself available to reporters. The boo-birds have begun to surface, as his season home batting average is .212. "We've talked about Travis a lot this year," Vogt said. "He came here with expectations and both on himself and from the outside. It's not easy." Griffin was a surprising trade-deadline acquisition last month, coming from the Washington Nationals after making the National League All-Star team. He is 3-1 with a 3.96 ERA with Cleveland, winning three straight decisions. In two career games against the Tigers, he is 2-0 with a 1.35 ERA, including a five-inning start on Aug. 12 at Detroit. Allen has worked out of the bullpen in his last four appearances, most recently starting on July 18 with a 3 1/3-inning effort against the Pittsburgh Pirates to begin his latest stint in the majors. He has been shelled by the Tigers in four career games, all starts, going 0-3 with a 7.00 ERA while giving up five homers in 18 innings. --Field Level Media

item.title: India's NSE targets listing in week of September 21 after IPO clearance, sources say
item.description: India's National Stock Exchange is planning to list in the week starting September 21, two sources familiar with the matter said, after the markets regulator cleared its long-awaited IPO on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Jayshree Pyasi, Vivek M
item.content:encoded: India's National Stock Exchange is planning to list in the week starting September 21, two sources familiar with the matter said, after the markets regulator cleared its long-awaited IPO on Friday. The exchange is expected to begin book-building, a process to gauge investor demand and determine the IPO price, on September 11, with the price band likely to be announced on September 15, the sources said, declining to be named as they were not authorised to speak to the media. NSE did not immediately respond to a Reuters' request for comment. Its share sale could rank among India's biggest-ever, alongside billionaire Mukesh Ambani's [USN:L4N44P0TT TEXT:"Jio"]. NSE has been valued at about $55 billion in the unlisted market, according to Reuters estimates, potentially placing it among the country's 10 most valuable companies by market capitalisation. NSE dominates trading in India's equity derivatives market and is the world's most active derivatives exchange by contracts traded. The exchange operates India's benchmark Nifty 50 index (.NSEI) . "Post listing NSE will be top 10 among India's largest companies in terms of market cap, which will garner huge interest from the market," said Deven Choksey, managing director of fund and wealth manager DRChoksey FinServ. "At an expected price-to-earnings valuation of around 35 times, the IPO would provide investors with headroom (for gains) after listing," Choksey said. CROWDED SPACE NSE's listing comes at a time when India's primary market is set for a record six IPOs on a single day next week, as companies hasten fundraising plans after a sluggish start to 2026 amid the U.S.-Iran war. It was unclear whether the NSE IPO would ease or intensify competition for investor attention, Arun Kejriwal, founder of Kejriwal Research and Investment Services, said. "I'm not sure whether NSE hitting the market at such a time will add to the pressure or reduce the pressure." NSE's proposed offering will be an offer for sale by existing shareholders, meaning NSE itself will not receive proceeds from the issue. Despite a recent clampdown on [USN:L4N44H17K TEXT:"derivatives trading"] by retail investors, India's capital markets penetration remains low compared with other major economies. The Securities and Exchange Board of India issued observations on NSE's draft prospectus, a key regulatory milestone that allows companies to proceed with the next steps towards launching share sales. NSE filed its draft red herring prospectus with SEBI on June 17, reviving a listing plan that had been held up since 2016 by regulatory scrutiny and legacy legal issues. NSE's listing ambitions had been delayed by investigations related to its co-location and dark-fibre facilities, as well as other regulatory matters. The clearance follows NSE's settlement of past lapses with SEBI, removing a major obstacle. Rival BSE (BSEL.NS) , which went public in 2017, has seen its shares surge 28-fold.

item.title: Exportadora de carne de frango, China será competidora do Brasil, avalia Rabobank
item.description: Com uma produção crescente de carne de frango, a China deverá ampliar sua participação nas exportações globais e acirrar a competição com o Brasil na próxima década em mercados importantes como o Oriente Médio, avaliou uma especialista chinesa do Rabobank no setor de carnes.
item.dc:creator: Roberto Samora
item.content:encoded: Com uma produção crescente de carne de frango, a China deverá ampliar sua participação nas exportações globais e acirrar a competição com o Brasil na próxima década em mercados importantes como o Oriente Médio, avaliou uma especialista chinesa do Rabobank no setor de carnes. Embora seja atualmente o principal destino da carne de frango brasileira, a China se tornou exportadora líquida da proteína desde 2025, vendendo excedentes de cortes menos consumidos no mercado doméstico, como o peito. E há espaço para crescer mais, disse Chenjun Pan, em entrevista à Reuters, durante sua passagem pelo escritório do Rabobank em São Paulo. "Acredito que, potencialmente -- não agora, mas talvez na próxima década --, possa haver alguma competição no Oriente Médio, na Ásia e na África" da carne de frango chinesa com a brasileira, disse a especialista. A China, o segundo produtor global atrás dos Estados Unidos, foi o quinto maior exportador no ano passado, segundo um relatório anual publicado pela associação da indústria brasileira, a ABPA. As exportações chinesas somaram pouco mais de 1 milhão de toneladas em 2025, enquanto o Brasil, maior exportador global, embarcou um recorde de 5,3 milhões de toneladas para o exterior. "A China já exporta carne de frango há muitos anos. Era principalmente carne processada. Mas, recentemente, o país começou a exportar grandes quantidades de carne in natura, como o peito de frango... esse segmento está crescendo rapidamente", disse Pan. Com a produção crescendo a uma taxa próxima de 10%, a China passou a gerar excedentes exportáveis, uma vez que o consumidor chinês demanda mais pés e asas -- produtos fortemente exportados pelo Brasil para lá --, mas menos cortes como o peito de frango, que tem maior demanda no exterior. "Os chineses não gostam de carne de peito por uma questão de hábito alimentar. Eles gostam de comer asas e pés", disse Pan. As exportações chinesas incluem destinos como a Rússia, Hong Kong, Coreia do Norte e países do Oriente Médio. Contudo, a China não compete com o Brasil em destinos da União Europeia, Japão e Coreia do Sul, uma vez que esses países não aceitam carne de frangos vacinados contra a gripe aviária, uma estratégia chinesa para reduzir impactos do vírus mortal. OPORTUNIDADE NA CRISE No primeiro semestre, a produção de carne de frango da China cresceu mais de 9% em relação ao mesmo período do ano passado, após ter avançado cerca de 7% em 2025, segundo a analista do Rabobank. "Então, está muito, muito forte o crescimento", afirmou. "O aumento da demanda é forte, mas não tão forte quanto o crescimento da produção", pontuou. A produção de carne de frango da China ganhou mais impulso nos últimos anos como parte da estratégia do governo para reduzir a dependência da carne suína -- os chineses são os maiores consumidores globais dessa proteína. Durante a crise da peste suína africana, entre 2019 e 2021, houve escassez de carne de porco e os preços dispararam, deixando também as cotações da proteína de frango muito altas. "Isso atraiu investimentos, expandindo a capacidade de produção de frango chinesa", disse a especialista, acrescentando que o movimento colaborou para a fatia do frango no mercado chinês de carnes ter avançado para 28%. A estratégia também leva em conta que a produção de frango exige menos milho e farelo de soja por unidade de proteína produzida do que a suinocultura, em um momento em que Pequim busca reduzir sua dependência das importações de grãos para ração. Segundo Pan, a migração do consumo para proteínas mais eficientes em termos de uso de ração, como o frango, aliada à expectativa de retração da produção de carne suína, tende a limitar o crescimento da demanda chinesa por soja. Por outro lado, Pan considera que a demanda chinesa por carne bovina tem potencial de crescer no futuro, ainda que no momento esse mercado sofra com restrições da oferta, que incluem tarifas de importação extracota mais altas para o Brasil e outros países. Ela ressaltou, contudo, que as tarifas mais elevadas devem permanecer até 2028, e que o Brasil poderia ter mais oportunidades depois disso, já que "a demanda na China está migrando de commodities para produtos de valor agregado".

item.title: Xi llevará una gran delegación de directores ejecutivos en su visita a EEUU, según fuentes
item.description: El presidente chino, Xi Jinping, está preparando una amplia delegación empresarial para que le acompañe en su visita a Washington, según dos fuentes, una medida inusual teniendo en cuenta el escepticismo de Estados Unidos hacia la inversión china y las tensas relaciones de Pekín con la empresa privada.
item.dc:creator: Laurie Chen, Eduardo Baptista
item.content:encoded: El presidente chino, Xi Jinping, está preparando una amplia delegación empresarial para que le acompañe en su visita a Washington, según dos fuentes, una medida inusual teniendo en cuenta el escepticismo de Estados Unidos hacia la inversión china y las tensas relaciones de Pekín con la empresa privada. Xi rara vez viaja al extranjero con ejecutivos de empresas, muchos de los cuales cayeron en desgracia tras las medidas reguladoras de Pekín contra los sectores tecnológico, educativo e inmobiliario que comenzaron en 2020. La delegación empresarial prevista para la cumbre del 24 de septiembre no se había dado a conocer hasta ahora. Reuters no pudo determinar qué ejecutivos formarán parte de la delegación. Esta medida tiene como objetivo, en parte, mostrar la voluntad de China de apoyar la inversión y los lazos comerciales con EEUU, al tiempo que ofrece a la Casa Blanca algunos posibles beneficios económicos de cara a las elecciones de mitad de mandato, según dijo una de las fuentes familiarizadas con las conversaciones. En los últimos años, las empresas chinas se han enfrentado a un escrutinio cada vez mayor de sus inversiones y operaciones comerciales en Estados Unidos. Washington ha impuesto un arancel del 100% a los vehículos eléctricos chinos importados, ha prohibido las importaciones de drones, "routers" y robots extranjeros, y ha obligado a la desinversión de las operaciones de TikTok en EEUU. También ha incluido a las principales empresas tecnológicas chinas en la Lista de Entidades (Entity List), que recoge a las empresas u organizaciones consideradas una amenaza para la seguridad nacional, así como en una lista negra del Pentágono. La última vez que Xi llevó una nutrida delegación empresarial a EEUU fue en 2015, entre los que se encontraban el fundador de Alibaba (9988.HK) , Jack Ma; el fundador de Tencent (0700.HK) , Pony Ma; y ejecutivos de bancos chinos y empresas estatales. Durante esa visita, China firmó un acuerdo por valor de 38.000 millones de dólares para la adquisición de 300 aviones Boeing (BA.N) , y Xi se reunió con directivos del sector tecnológico estadounidense, entre ellos el director ejecutivo de Apple (AAPL.O) , Tim Cook; el director ejecutivo de Meta (META.O) , Mark Zuckerberg; y el fundador de Amazon (AMZN.O) , Jeff Bezos. Por el contrario, el presidente de EEUU, Donald Trump, ha viajado a China con amplias delegaciones de ejecutivos estadounidenses —entre otras, en sus visitas de 2017 y de mayo de este año— con el objetivo de conseguir un mayor acceso a los mercados chinos. UNA GRAN DELEGACIÓN EMPRESARIAL ESTADOUNIDENSE VISITÓ PEKÍN En mayo, Trump se llevó a China a 18 ejecutivos estadounidenses, entre ellos el director ejecutivo de Nvidia (NVDA.O) , Jensen Huang, y Elon Musk, según indicaron las fuentes. "Mi impresión es que los chinos (…) van a dar más importancia al papel de estos empresarios al incluirlos en la delegación", dijo Scott Kennedy, experto en negocios chinos del Centro de Estudios Estratégicos e Internacionales. La participación de los ejecutivos podría resultar "realmente valiosa", añadió. Kennedy comparó el enfoque chino con la organización de la delegación estadounidense de mayo, que, según él, se formó con poca antelación y cuyos ejecutivos fueron "más observadores pasivos que participantes activos". El Tesoro de EEUU, la Oficina del Representante Comercial de EEUU y el Departamento de Estado no respondieron a las solicitudes de comentarios de Reuters. Los ministerios de Asuntos Exteriores y de Comercio de China no respondieron de inmediato a las solicitudes de comentarios. CUMBRE SIMBÓLICA Ambos países anunciaron en mayo mecanismos formales para gestionar las relaciones comerciales y de inversión. Sin embargo, tres fuentes independientes informadas sobre el asunto señalaron que es poco probable que la Junta de Inversiones genere resultados significativos en la cumbre debido al difícil entorno que existe en EEUU para la inversión china. Las expectativas respecto a la cumbre siguen siendo modestas, con perspectivas limitadas de avances importantes, según las fuentes. Pekín y Washington también siguen sin ponerse de acuerdo sobre qué productos deberían considerarse "no sensibles" en el marco de la Junta de Comercio, según las tres fuentes. Se está debatiendo la inclusión de unas diez categorías de productos "no sensibles", pero esto podría cambiar a medida que se acerque la cumbre, según una de las fuentes. JUNTA DE COMERCIO Llegar a un acuerdo sobre la Junta de Comercio es una de las principales prioridades de Estados Unidos para la cumbre, junto con la obtención de más licencias de exportación de tierras raras para las empresas estadounidenses, según las fuentes. Un representante estadounidense anónimo dijo que el Gobierno sigue presionando a sus homólogos chinos para que aborden el incumplimiento por parte de China del acuerdo anunciado en Busan en octubre, que garantizó una tregua comercial de un año que suspendió temporalmente algunos controles a la exportación y aranceles, así como otras cuestiones bilaterales. Pekín ha presionado para obtener una mayor reducción arancelaria. El Ministerio de Comercio chino afirmó en julio que ambas partes estaban estudiando reducciones arancelarias recíprocas que abarcarían productos por valor de 30.000 millones de dólares. Aunque en febrero la Corte Suprema de EEUU anuló los aranceles relacionados con China impuestos en virtud de la Ley de Poderes Económicos de Emergencia Internacional, Washington introdujo posteriormente un arancel global del 10% sobre las importaciones. El representante comercial de EEUU, Jamieson Greer, dijo el jueves que ambos países harán "algunos anuncios sobre agricultura y barreras no arancelarias" durante la cumbre, sin dar más detalles. El secretario del Tesoro de EEUU, Scott Bessent, Greer y el vice primer ministro chino He Lifeng se reunirán a principios de septiembre para debatir los posibles resultados de la cumbre, según informaron cuatro fuentes a Reuters. Reuters no pudo determinar la fecha ni el lugar exactos de las conversaciones.

item.title: Empresas chinas de tierras raras suspenden algunos envíos a EEUU por la inquietud geopolítica
item.description: Algunos proveedores chinos de tierras raras se están negando a realizar envíos a EEUU por temor a las represalias de Pekín, según tres fuentes, lo que pone de relieve que el acceso a estos materiales sigue siendo un problema para EEUU a pocas semanas de la visita del presidente Xi Jinping a Washington.
item.dc:creator: Laurie Chen, Solomon Cefai, Trevor Hunnicutt, Lewis Jackson
item.content:encoded: Algunos proveedores chinos de tierras raras se están negando a realizar envíos a EEUU por temor a las represalias de Pekín, según tres fuentes, lo que pone de relieve que el acceso a estos materiales sigue siendo un problema para EEUU a pocas semanas de la visita del presidente Xi Jinping a Washington. Las autoridades estadounidenses han pedido repetidamente a China que respete los compromisos adquiridos en Busan y Pekín durante el último año para garantizar la fluidez en la concesión de licencias de exportación de tierras raras. La persistencia del problema lo ha situado en la agenda de planificación de EEUU de cara a la visita de Xi el 24 de septiembre, según una fuente familiarizada con el asunto. Un puñado de proveedores chinos se ha negado a enviar tierras raras a empresas estadounidenses desde principios de agosto, cuando China impuso sanciones a la Responsible Business Alliance (RBA), un organismo estadounidense de supervisión de la cadena de suministro, según indicó otra fuente con conocimiento directo de la situación. Dado que China está desplegando sus propias armas de cumplimiento comercial, las empresas temían ser sancionadas por Pekín por cumplir con el marco de diligencia debida de la Iniciativa de Minerales Responsables (RMI, por sus siglas en inglés), un programa global de auditoría de la cadena de suministro de minerales vinculado a la RBA, según la fuente. Otras empresas chinas de tierras raras ya habían interrumpido los envíos a EEUU para evitar verse envueltas en la geopolítica en los últimos meses, según indicaron otras dos fuentes familiarizadas con el sector. Una de ellas señaló cuatro casos en los que empresas chinas se negaron a enviar material por temor a que pudiera revenderse a usuarios prohibidos. Las fuentes prefirieron mantener el anonimato dada la delicadeza del asunto. Reuters no pudo determinar el número total de proveedores chinos que se habían negado a realizar envíos destinados a clientes estadounidenses. Un funcionario estadounidense que habló bajo condición de anonimato dijo a Reuters que el Gobierno sigue presionando a sus homólogos chinos para que aborden el incumplimiento por parte de China del acuerdo de Busan, así como otras cuestiones bilaterales. ESCASEZ DE OFERTA Aunque las exportaciones de muchas tierras raras o imanes relacionados se han recuperado desde que China impuso restricciones en abril de 2025, los precios de ciertas tierras raras y materiales críticos, como el itrio, el fosfuro de indio y el tungsteno —con aplicaciones militares o en sectores sensibles como el aeroespacial o la fabricación de chips—, siguen cerca de máximos históricos debido a la escasez de oferta. Otros sectores afectados por los retrasos en la concesión de licencias son el de los dispositivos médicos y el energético. Las exportaciones de itrio a EEUU han aumentado este año, pero siguen situándose solo en torno a la mitad de los niveles de 2024, a pesar de los grandes envíos a otros países, según muestran los datos de las aduanas chinas. Algunas empresas estadounidenses llevan más de seis meses esperando licencias para minerales, según indicaron dos de las fuentes, que prefirieron mantener el anonimato. "China ha sido muy eficaz a la hora de utilizar los controles a la exportación de tierras raras para imponer restricciones a la Oficina de Industria y Seguridad del Departamento de Comercio", dijo Reva Goujon, estratega geopolítica de Rhodium Group, refiriéndose a la agencia estadounidense responsable de diversas restricciones dirigidas contra China. "Los cuellos de botella en la cadena de suministro pasarán a primer plano, pero esperaría que Pekín flexibilizara un poco los controles sobre las materias primas críticas en torno a la cumbre para desmontar las acusaciones de EEUU de que Pekín no está respetando la tregua de Busan", añadió Goujon. El Tesoro de EEUU, la Oficina del Representante Comercial de EEUU, el Departamento de Estado y el Ministerio de Comercio de China no respondieron a las solicitudes de comentarios. El Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores de China afirmó que el país se compromete a mantener las cadenas de suministro mundiales de minerales críticos. Pekín afirmó que su decisión de agosto de sancionar a la RBA y a otras firmas de auditoría estadounidenses fue una respuesta a una serie de restricciones impuestas por la Comisión Federal de Comunicaciones (FCC, por sus siglas en inglés) desde diciembre y dirigidas contra laboratorios chinos de pruebas de productos electrónicos, drones, "routers" de consumo, cables submarinos, equipos robóticos avanzados e inversores eléctricos. Cuando los funcionarios estadounidenses han planteado la cuestión de las tierras raras en las reuniones, los funcionarios chinos han replicado que las medidas de la FCC constituían una violación del acuerdo de Busan, según una de las fuentes informadas sobre el intercambio. Sin embargo, tras dos meses sin exportaciones de itrio, China envió 27 toneladas de este material a EEUU en julio, el segundo mayor volumen mensual desde enero de 2025.

item.title: ByteDance secures $29.6 billion loan in AI push, sources say
item.description: ByteDance has secured a $29.6 billion loan from nearly 30 banks, three people with direct knowledge of the matter said on Friday, with the Chinese social media giant's bet on AI development driving strong interest from lenders.
item.dc:creator: Kane Wu, Yantoultra Ngui
item.content:encoded: ByteDance has secured a $29.6 billion loan from nearly 30 banks, three people with direct knowledge of the matter said on Friday, with the Chinese social media giant's bet on AI development driving strong interest from lenders. The loan is the second-largest made in Asia this year after SoftBank [USN:L4N40F0NV TEXT:"raised $40 billion"] in March to boost OpenAI investments, underscoring lenders' enthusiasm for the sector which demands ever-increasing capital. Chinese, U.S., European and Singaporean banks are participating in the financing, the people said, with the three-year loan co-ordinated by Citigroup (C.N) and JPMorgan (JPM.N) set to be signed by ByteDance shortly. ByteDance and JPMorgan did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Citi declined to comment. Bloomberg News first reported on the loan on Thursday. The owner of popular social media apps Douyin and TikTok increased the facility from an initial target of $20 billion after an overwhelming response from lenders, said the people, who declined to be named as the information was confidential. Chinese banks have subscribed to more than 60% of the total amount, one of them added. ByteDance told lenders the financing would be for general corporate purposes, but the people said that the funds will mainly support the company's AI-related plans. The facility has an initial term of three years and options to extend for two more years, two of them said. RARE UNSECURED MEGA LOAN ByteDance has stepped up its AI spending. Reuters [USN:L6N42N08E TEXT:"reported"] in June that the tech firm was in talks with Shanghai-based Iluvatar CoreX (9903.HK) to purchase AI chips for inference work and is also considering a similar deal with Baidu (9888.HK) . The new dollar-denominated facility is unsecured, meaning ByteDance is not pledging any asset or shares as collateral, reflecting how confidently lenders view the company's creditworthiness. "It is very rare to see such a mega loan unsecured," said one of the sources. "The banks practically are counting purely on ByteDance's name." The loan will be used to fund projects outside China, the source said, adding ByteDance is the offtaker for many of the data centers being built in Southeast Asia. An offtaker signs a binding contract with a data center to purchase a certain amount of its capacity. "ByteDance is competing with local hyperscalers on AI data centers and with global hyperscalers on multimodal AI model," said Lian Jye Su, chief analyst at research firm Omdia. "Both require massive investment, especially if we look at the Capex poured into AI training by the likes of OpenAI and Google," he said. ByteDance last tapped the global loan market in September 2024, raising $10.8 billion from roughly 20 international and Chinese lenders, according to a Bloomberg report at the time.

item.title: Norway offers a case study in US financial gravity
item.description: The manager of the country's $2.3 trln sovereign fund may reduce American government debt to 22% of its bond index, from 34% now. Yet it's mostly a way to buy more US state-backed mortgage securities instead. Diversifying away from dollar assets, including equities too, is hard.
item.dc:creator: Liam Proud
item.content:encoded: The manager of the country's $2.3 trln sovereign fund may reduce American government debt to 22% of its bond index, from 34% now. Yet it's mostly a way to buy more US state-backed mortgage securities instead. Diversifying away from dollar assets, including equities too, is hard. Full view will be published shortly. Follow Liam Proud on Bluesky and LinkedIn . The manager of Norway's $2.3 trillion sovereign wealth fund has proposed significantly cutting its exposure to U.S. Treasuries as part of a wider shake-up of its bond investments to improve returns, according to a letter sent to the country's finance ministry on September 1. Norges Bank Investment Management has recommended reducing its weighting to government bonds within its benchmark bond index to 50% from 70%. "We recommend that the government subindex of the bond index be reduced from 70% to 50%," Ida Wolden Bache, governor of Norges Bank, and Norges Bank IM CEO Nicolai Tangen wrote in the letter. "A government share of 50% will be sufficient to cover the liquidity needs, including in periods of turbulence in financial markets." While U.S. Treasuries exposure would fall, the proposed allocation to U.S. non-government debt would jump from 16.2% to 27.6%, meaning that the overall bond index's weighting to the U.S. dollar would fall only slightly, from 52.9% to 52.5%. item.title: EU sends boats to the English Channel to help tackle 'migration crisis'
item.description: The European Union's border agency will send boats out into the English Channel and the North Sea to help search for and rescue migrants, officials said on Friday, days after France and Britain's leaders met and discussed migration.
item.dc:creator: Sudip Kar-Gupta
item.content:encoded: The European Union's border agency will send boats out into the English Channel and the North Sea to help search for and rescue migrants, officials said on Friday, days after France and Britain's leaders met and discussed migration. The Frontex agency will send out two Spanish boats from September to October, and then one from Lithuania up to January, to join French patrols, authorities managing the area said. The Channel is one of the world's busiest shipping lanes, and [USN:L1N3Z10LK TEXT:"many migrants have died"] in its strong currents trying to cross from France to Britain. Human traffickers regularly overload dinghies, leaving them barely afloat. In August, French coastguards had [USN:L8N44113F TEXT:"to rescue"] 157 people from a boat that caught fire. "In response to the ongoing migration crisis in the Channel, Frontex will deploy patrol vessels to complement temporarily French assets engaged in search and rescue operations," read a statement from the France-based Maritime Prefecture for the Channel and the North Sea. [USN:L8N4400Z3 TEXT:"Migration"] is one of Europe's most divisive political issues, including in Britain where the ruling Labour party is facing a challenge from the populist Reform UK party, which has vowed to stop migrants arriving in boats. Britain said in April it would [USN:L8N4151VD TEXT:"pay France"] up to £660 million ($892.72 million) under a three-year border security deal to curb illegal migrant crossings of the Channel, with part of the funding contingent on results. Last year, both countries agreed a [USN:L8N3T6167 TEXT:""one in, one out""] pilot scheme under which France will accept the return of undocumented people arriving in Britain by small boats, in exchange for Britain agreeing to accept an equal number of legitimate asylum seekers with British family connections. item.title: Nove dias após desastre, duas pessoas são resgatadas com vida de túnel hidrelétrico no Nepal
item.description: Equipes de resgate retiraram na sexta-feira dois sobreviventes de um túnel ligado a uma usina hidrelétrica no rio Trishuli, no Nepal, nove dias depois que uma onda de gelo, rocha e lama varreu o vale, matando mais de 1.300 pessoas e deixando mais de 5.600 desaparecidas.
item.dc:creator: Gopal Sharma, Saurabh Sharma
item.content:encoded: Equipes de resgate retiraram na sexta-feira dois sobreviventes de um túnel ligado a uma usina hidrelétrica no rio Trishuli, no Nepal, nove dias depois que uma onda de gelo, rocha e lama varreu o vale, matando mais de 1.300 pessoas e deixando mais de 5.600 desaparecidas. Autoridades e equipes de resgate acreditam que o desabamento de uma geleira, ocorrido em 26 de agosto na parte superior do rio, tenha deixado pelo menos 900 pessoas presas em túneis ligados a seis projetos hidrelétricos ao longo do curso d’água. Os dois trabalhadores retirados do túnel na Usina Hidrelétrica Upper Trishuli 3A são os primeiros a serem resgatados dos projetos hidrelétricos e foram levados a um hospital do Exército na capital, Catmandu, dando às equipes de busca um lampejo de esperança à medida que a possibilidade de encontrar outros sobreviventes se esvai. Vídeos divulgados pelas autoridades nepalesas mostraram Kabir Maharjan sendo içado de um buraco no chão enquanto os espectadores aplaudiam, e depois colocado em uma maca. Seu colega Sanjay Sah foi retirado nas costas de um trabalhador, com o rosto ainda coberto de lama, antes que médicos do Exército colocassem uma máscara de oxigênio nele e verificassem seus sinais vitais dentro de uma tenda de resgate. Sah, um encarregado mecânico, descreveu mais tarde como ficou para trás em uma sala de controle para ajudar outros a escapar, depois de ter instado os colegas a fugirem ao ouvir a notícia do desastre. “Eu estava na sala de controle, então minha responsabilidade era salvar a vida de todos. Quando ocorreu um acidente tão grave, não era certo eu fugir”, disse ele em uma gravação de vídeo compartilhada pelas autoridades nepalesas. Sah contou às equipes de resgate que passou algum tempo recitando mantras (versos de uma oração) enquanto estava preso. Ele disse que havia mantido contato com mais três ou quatro pessoas no túnel, enquanto outras ainda poderiam estar vivas em trechos mais profundos do túnel. Pelo menos 1.287 pessoas morreram no Nepal nas enchentes que arrasaram casas, ruas e escolas em cidades e vilarejos próximos à fronteira com o Tibete, na China, informou na sexta-feira a autoridade responsável pela gestão de desastres. Mais de 5.080 ainda estão desaparecidas. A China estimou o número de mortos no Tibete em 21, com outras 541 pessoas listadas como desaparecidas.

item.title: Psychedelic drug shows promise for preventing chemotherapy-induced nerve damage
item.description: Today we feature two early studies, one that points toward a possible way to prevent nerve damage from chemotherapy drugs and another that reveals previously unrecognized effects of bacteria that are known to make adults very sick but that were thought to be harmless to babies.
item.dc:creator: Nancy Lapid
item.content:encoded: (This is an excerpt of the Health Rounds newsletter, where we present latest medical studies on Tuesdays and Thursdays) Today we feature two early studies, one that points toward a possible way to prevent nerve damage from chemotherapy drugs and another that reveals previously unrecognized effects of bacteria that are known to make adults very sick but that were thought to be harmless to babies. PSYCHEDELIC DRUG MAY PREVENT CHEMOTHERAPY NERVE DAMAGE The psychedelic drug psilocybin may help prevent the nerve damage that often accompanies chemotherapy, studies in mice suggest. Chemotherapy-related peripheral neuropathy can result in pain, numbness, increased sensitivity to cold, and loss of sensation that linger long after treatment ends and are often irreversible. In mice, two doses of psilocybin given before chemotherapy prevented hypersensitivity to cold, protected sensory nerve endings and preserved touch sensation without affecting chemotherapy’s antitumor activity, researchers reported on Thursday in Science . Psilocybin directly affects the peripheral nervous system through brain cell surface proteins called serotonin 5-HT2A receptors. Blocking the 5-HT2A pathway reversed the drug’s neuroprotective effects, while using a non-hallucinogenic compound that activates the same brain-cell surface proteins produced similar protection to psilocybin. Psilocybin also helped protect nerve cells’ mitochondria – their “energy factories” – from the damaging effects of chemotherapy drugs, the researchers found. “There is an urgent need for treatments that prevent nerve injury without interfering with lifesaving chemotherapy,” study leader Dr. Moran Amit of the University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center said in a statement. “These findings offer important insights into how psilocybin may protect nerves before damage occurs, rather than treating symptoms after they become persistent.” His team’s findings are the basis for an upcoming mid-stage trial evaluating psilocybin during chemotherapy in patients with multiple cancer types to determine whether the mechanisms observed in the lab translate to clinically meaningful reductions in peripheral neuropathy in patients. IN BABIES, C. DIFF BACTERIA CAUSE DAMAGE WITHOUT SYMPTOMS “C. diff” infections in infants don’t produce the severe gastrointestinal symptoms the bacteria cause in adults, and so the fact that 40% to 90% of infants in industrialized countries have the organisms in their intestines hasn’t worried doctors – until now. Without causing symptoms, the Clostridioides difficile bacterium can reshape the developing infant gut and induce changes with long-term consequences, researchers have discovered. In adults, toxins produced by C. diff cause symptoms ranging from severe diarrhea to fatal colonic inflammation. Around half a million patients are infected in the U.S. annually, resulting in approximately 30,000 fatal cases. Infants, however, always seemed to be resistant to the effects of the bacterium. “But… does asymptomatic really mean inconsequential? Could a toxin-producing pathogen actually be reshaping the developing gut without causing obvious symptoms?” study leader Joseph Zackular of Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP) said in a statement. In studies of mice and in lab tests of intestinal biopsy samples from human infants and mini-intestines made from human tissue in test-tubes, the researchers found the presence of C. diff led to remodeling of the epithelium — the layer of cells that line the gut – and reshaping of the immune system that protects the intestines’ moist inner surfaces. These effects were also observed in the intestines of human infants colonized with C. diff, the researchers reported on Thursday in Science . “The infant gut epithelium is still building itself, so C. diff doesn't just injure it; it can alter the developmental trajectory of the tissue in ways that may last into adulthood,” study co-author Kathryn Hamilton, also at CHOP, said in a statement. The authors add that the long-term consequences of these effects need to be studied in more detail. They also hope to develop a maternal vaccine that would target C. diff, similar to vaccines already in use that immunize mothers to protect newborns against RSV and pertussis. item.title: Weeks after mass abduction, Nigerian families seek news from kidnappers, action from government
item.description: Two weeks after gunmen raided the northwestern Nigerian village of Dekera, killing dozens and kidnapping hundreds, residents and family members say they have heard nothing from the kidnappers and seen little action from the government.
item.dc:creator: Hamza Ibrahim
item.content:encoded: Two weeks after gunmen raided the northwestern Nigerian village of Dekera, killing dozens and kidnapping hundreds, residents and family members say they have heard nothing from the kidnappers and seen little action from the government. Mass kidnappings for [USN:L6N44N0Z4 TEXT:"ransom"] are relatively common across much of northern Nigeria, but the coordinated [USN:L6N44L0LU TEXT:"August 22 "][USN:L6N44L0LU TEXT:"attack"] on communities in north-central Niger state was one of the biggest in recent years, underscoring the extent of insecurity as the country heads towards an election next year. "We haven't heard anything from the kidnappers since the abduction," Isa Zaki, a Dekera resident with 10 members of his extended family among those seized, told Reuters by telephone. Zaki said years of insecurity had already resulted in local schools and markets closing, but residents were increasingly desperate after the August attack, which he said had killed dozens and resulted in much of Dekera being burned. "People have fled, soldiers have taken over the town, houses have been burnt, there is nowhere to live, and it is raining," he said. "It's been sadness over sadness since the abduction." "NO ONE IS TELLING US ANYTHING" Residents say about 600 people, mostly women, children and older people, were abducted in Dekera and nearby Gidan-Zana and Sabon Gida communities in the raid. At least 40 residents were also killed, they said. Authorities have not commented on the number of hostages or deaths, but President Bola Tinubu [USN:L8N44M106 TEXT:"has ordered"] security agencies to rescue the hostages. "We have no update yet. When we have, we will share accordingly," said Wasiu Abiodun, Niger state police spokesperson. Civil servant Habibu Salihu said his sister gave birth a week before she, her husband and three children, including the newborn, were kidnapped. Salihu said seven other family members were killed and he saw his sister breastfeeding her child in a video of hostages released by the kidnappers soon after the attack, but has had no news since then. "We have no information on what is going on. No one is telling us anything and we have no idea what action the government is taking to rescue the hostages," he said. 'OUR HOUSES ARE NOTHING BUT ASHES' No group has claimed responsibility yet, but analysts suspect a breakaway sect in the area of the Islamist militant group Boko Haram, which usually operates in north-eastern Nigeria, was involved. Local authorities in north-eastern Benin have confirmed a number of people fled into the country after the incident but they gave no details on numbers. Residents say the deployment of soldiers has brought some relief, but families are still homeless and growing increasingly hungry. "Our town has been burnt," said Aminu Inuwa, who lost two brothers in the raid. "I have only one shirt, no food to eat, nothing else and our houses are nothing but ashes."

item.title: TSX futures muted ahead of domestic, US jobs reports
item.description: Futures tracking Canada's blue-chip stocks were subdued on Friday, as investors refrained from placing large bets ahead of crucial U.S. and Canadian jobs reports that could influence monetary policy expectations.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Futures tracking Canada's blue-chip stocks were subdued on Friday, as investors refrained from placing large bets ahead of crucial U.S. and Canadian jobs reports that could influence monetary policy expectations. September futures on the S&P/TSX index were muted by 06:36 a.m. ET (1036 GMT), though trading volumes were low. Crucial data on U.S. jobs is scheduled to be released before markets open and will provide more clarity on how the U.S. labor market is holding up. Canada will also release its jobs data. Investors will keep a close eye on the U.S. employment report as the Federal Reserve's September 15 to 16 monetary policy meeting looms, with markets split between an interest rate hike and no move, according to LSEG data. Bets that rates could increase this month have swung recently as U.S. inflation data painted a mixed picture, with Fed Chair Kevin Warsh not providing clear forward guidance. However, Fed Governor Christopher Waller said on Thursday that recent data showed some signs of disinflation and if the trend continued, he would [USN:SPN44A01W TEXT:"favor holding rates"] steady at the September meeting. Meanwhile, gold and silver prices were [USN:L1N44W06V TEXT:"steady"] on Friday, while oil inched lower, putting mining and energy stocks in focus when markets open. Renewed strikes in the Middle East pushed up oil prices and bond yields this week, creating an uncertain backdrop for risk assets. Yields have since retreated from their recent highs. The benchmark TSX is headed for gains this week, its first in three, with energy stocks on track to outperform peers this week. Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney [USN:L6N44V13Y TEXT:"said"] on Thursday, that his government was ready to sign a trade deal with U.S. that benefits both countries.
